title: PortFile

port.description: The port the environment's listener is bound to on loopback.

environmentId.description: An environment's persistent id: a UUID made on its first start, kept across address changes.

environmentName.description: The environment's name, for the extension's options page.

harnessVersion.description: The harness version the environment runs, which the folder's extension was built with.

description: The port file in the extension's folder: the listener's port, the environment's id and name, and the harness version.
